about: What bw 2026.4.2 REALLY printed on 18/11/2026, in a throwaway data folder (BITWARDENCLI_APPDATA_DIR), its server set to an address that cannot be reached: a closed port (ECONNREFUSED), a name that does not exist (ENOTFOUND), an address that never answers (ETIMEDOUT); and, on the EU cloud, a sign-in refused for an account that does not exist. Verbatim, except the line that named the throwaway folder. A refused master password at unlock could not be captured without a real account.
